rationale: M49 W1 (#768): (1) the write-LHS suppression used `continue` inside a stack walk that pushes children at the loop tail, so the whole statement subtree was skipped — reads nested in the LHS were silently lost (`document.getElementById(id).style.display = v` dropped the read of `id`; `store.inner.limit = v` dropped `store`/`inner`). The code comment claimed the opposite ('inner segments of a chained write stay reads'). (2) The chain head was emitted as raw node text, so a call-rooted chain fabricated a non-symbol target `uses -> document.getElementById(id)`. Both are now suppressed per-node instead of per-subtree, and the head is emitted only when it is an identifier. Missed by every fixture until the #760 cold-pool rotation surfaced them on grails-core (MISSING=7) and lodash (MISSING=26).
